name: Available At IP Address
description: This port is reachable at this address: the transport endpoint answers there. Drawn to the ip_address whose network and address are the port's own key (tap.computing.network_name, address), one per port. A reference, not containment: the address exists without the port. The observational shape (req-computing-core-ports-6): a source that sees an address and a port, but neither the interface the port is bound to nor the program listening on it, says only this. A listening program (LISTENS_ON) and an interface binding (ATTACHED_TO) are separate, stronger claims, not built.
